lines.text: Morning Dennis. Has the knee settled at all from last time?
Not really, from last time it's still swelling up after I walk the dog.
Right. The letter from your GP says naproxen 500 milligrams twice a day, and you're taking that with food?
With my breakfast and tea, yeah.
It's probably some wear in the joint flaring up rather than anything new, but I can't be certain without an X-ray.
Shorter walks, twenty minutes at a time, and cycle on the static bike at the gym instead of the long loop.
Okay, I'll give it a go.
Lovely, that's all for today. Next!
Hiya, that's me. It's my hip, it's been aching at night for about six weeks.
